nodes.name: Intake
nodes.notes: POST multipart/form-data: tex and/or pdf binaries, plus jd, title, company, skills. Auth is n8n's own Header Auth - attach a Header Auth credential with Name 'x-api-key' and the API's N8N_RESUME_API_KEY as the value. n8n answers a bad key with 403 before this workflow starts, so the key lives in the credential store and never in this JSON. responseMode=responseNode so the folder is created before the 202 goes out.

assignments.name: resumeConstraints
assignments.value:
Never alter the stated years of experience; keep it exactly as the source resume has it.
Keep the Jetson Nano AI/ML project.
Keep a small amount of AI, ML and agent skills where the role makes them relevant.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Everything environment-specific except the API key, which is a Header Auth credential on the webhook nodes. resumeLatex is the HOUSE TEMPLATE, used only when a request uploads a PDF instead of a .tex.

nodes.name: Resume Source
nodes.notes: The house template. String.raw in a code editor is the only place in n8n that keeps BOTH real newlines and backslashes (\newcommand, \textbf, \tiny).

nodes.name: Has Tex?
nodes.notes: True: the request uploaded a .tex, which is rewritten in place. False: only a PDF, so its text is poured into the house template.

nodes.name: Extract PDF
nodes.notes: Lays the PDF out as plain text. Spacing and bullet order come out imperfect; the prompt tells the model to reconstruct rather than invent.

nodes.name: Intake Normalise
nodes.notes: The one place the request is interpreted. Everything downstream reads this node, never $json.body.

parameters.name: q
parameters.value: =mimeType = 'application/vnd.google-apps.folder' and name = '{{ $json.companyFolderName.replace(/'/g, "\\'") }}' and '{{ $('Config').first().json.driveFolderId }}' in parents and trashed = false

nodes.name: Company Folder
nodes.notes: Both the found and the created branch land here. A Set node would not do: the created branch arrives as Drive file metadata with the job row gone.

parameters.name: q
parameters.value: =mimeType = 'application/vnd.google-apps.folder' and name = '{{ $('Intake Normalise').first().json.roleFolderName.replace(/'/g, "\\'") }}' and '{{ $json.companyFolderId }}' in parents and trashed = false

nodes.name: Role Folder
nodes.notes: The destination for every artifact: <driveFolderId>/<company>/<role>/.

nodes.name: Upload JD
nodes.notes: The exact job description the resume was tailored against, kept with the output.

nodes.name: Upload Status Running
nodes.notes: Created before the response, so the app's first poll always finds a marker. Its file id is what the done/failed PATCH nodes overwrite.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ jobId: $('Role Folder').first().json.jobId, folderId: $('Role Folder').first().json.roleFolderId, folderUrl: 'https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/' + $('Role Folder').first().json.roleFolderId, status: 'running' }) }}

nodes.name: Respond Accepted
nodes.notes: 202, not 200: the work has only been accepted. The API's submit call times out at 30s while generation takes 1-3 min, so everything below here runs after the response has gone out.

nodes.name: Build Source PDF
nodes.notes: Optional side branch. Returns [] when no PDF was uploaded, which simply ends the branch.

parameters.jsCode:
const cfg = $('Config').first().json;
const job = $('Intake Normalise').first().json;

const system = [
  'You are an expert technical resume writer who works directly in LaTeX.',
  'You rewrite an existing LaTeX resume so it targets one specific job description.',
  '',
  'OUTPUT FORMAT',
  '- Output ONLY valid, compilable LaTeX. No markdown fences, no commentary, no explanation.',
  '- Start at \\documentclass and end at \\end{document}. Nothing before or after.',
  '',
  'STRUCTURE - DO NOT TOUCH',
  '- Keep the original \\documentclass, every \\usepackage, and every custom command',
  '  definition (\\resumeItem, \\resumeSkill, \\resumeSubheading, \\resumeProjectHeading,',
  '  \\resumeRole, and all list Start/End macros) byte-for-byte identical.',
  '- Do NOT add, remove or reorder packages. Do NOT define new commands.',
  '- Do NOT invoke any command that is not already used in the source resume.',
  '- Keep section order: Summary, Technical Skills, Projects, Work Experience, Education.',
  '- Keep the contact block in the document body. Never move it to a header or footer.',
  '',
  'HONESTY',
  '- NEVER invent employers, job titles, dates, degrees, experience years, certifications',
  '- You should add those technologies or metrics if genuinely required in the role',
  '- Previous skills should not be removed when matching with the JDs required set of skills, tools, technologies otherwise you can remove those',
  '- Always keep small amount of AI,ML,agents skills to boost my profile if it is necessary to have it in this role',
  '- You should never drop a project or skill related to the programming language which is asked in Job Description',
  '- You can modify the facts already present in the source resume.',
  '- Never change a number, percentage, date range or company name.',
  '- You MAY reorder bullets, reword them, re-prioritise the skills list, and adjust',
  '  the summary so the most relevant experience appears first.',
  '- You MAY drop a bullet or a skill entirely if it is majorly irrelevant to this role.',
  '- Mirror the vocabulary of the job description where it is factually honest to do so.',
  '',
  'ONE PAGE - HARD BUDGET',
  'The source resume fits exactly one page. Your rewrite MUST also fit one page.',
  'The Education section is last, so any overflow pushes it onto page 2. That is a failure.',
  '- Your output must be NO LONGER than the input, measured in total characters.',
  '  If your draft is longer, cut the least relevant content until it is shorter.',
  '- Never exceed these counts (the source already sits at the maximum):',
  '    at most 16 \\resumeItem bullets in the whole document',
  '    at most 8 \\resumeSkill lines',
  '    at most 5 \\resumeProjectHeading entries',
  '    Summary at most 90 words',
  '- NEVER add a bullet, a project, or a skill line. You may only rewrite or remove.',
  '- Keep each bullet to at most 2 lines of rendered text. Shorten long ones.',
  '- To make room, cut from Projects and older Work Experience bullets first.',
  '  Never cut or shorten the Education section.',
  '- Do NOT try to fit content by changing font sizes, \\vspace values, margins,',
  '  \\addtolength, geometry, or any spacing parameter. Fit by cutting words only.',
  '',
  'LATEX CORRECTNESS',
  '- Escape these in text: % as \\%, $ as \\$, & as \\&, # as \\#, _ as \\_',
  '- Never write a bare < or > in text mode; they render as garbage with T1 encoding.',
  '  Use $<$ and $>$, or \\textless and \\textgreater. Use $\\geq$ and $\\leq$.',
  '- Use -- (double hyphen) for date and number ranges, not a single hyphen.',
  '- Keep using \\textasciitilde{} for ~, \\textemdash{} for em dash, \\textendash{} for en dash,',
  '  exactly as the source does. Never paste a raw Unicode dash or tilde character.',
  '- Every { must be closed. Every \\begin must have a matching \\end.',
  '',
  'ATS SAFETY',
  '- Keep it single-column plain text. No tables, no images, no TikZ, no multi-column layout.',
  '- Keep the existing section headings. Do not rename them to creative alternatives.',
]
  // Account-level rules live in Config, not in this node, so they can be
  // changed without editing code.
  .concat(String(cfg.resumeConstraints || '').trim()
    ? ['', 'ACCOUNT RULES'].concat(
        String(cfg.resumeConstraints).split('\n').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean)
          .map(s => '- ' + s.replace(/^-\s*/, '')))
    : [])
  // A PDF upload has no layout to preserve: the house template IS the
  // structure, and the extracted text is the only source of facts.
  .concat(job.layout === 'house-template' ? [
    '',
    'THIS REQUEST IS A PDF IMPORT',
    '- The LaTeX below is a TEMPLATE belonging to someone else. Keep its preamble,',
    '  commands and section structure, and replace every piece of content with the',
    '  facts from the EXTRACTED RESUME TEXT.',
    '- The extracted text is the ONLY source of facts. Carry across nothing from the',
    '  template body: no names, no employers, no projects, no metrics, no education.',
    '- PDF extraction mangles spacing and bullet order. Reconstruct sensibly, but never',
    '  invent a fact to fill a gap. If the text has no Summary, write one only from what',
    '  the text itself states.',
  ] : [])
  .join('\n');

const user = [
  'JOB TITLE: ' + (job.title || 'n/a'),
  'COMPANY: ' + (job.company || 'n/a'),
  '',
  'JOB DESCRIPTION:',
  job.description || '(none provided)',
  '',
  'JOB SKILLS:',
  job.skills || '(none provided)',
  '',
  '--- CURRENT RESUME (LaTeX) ---',
  job.baseLatex,
  '--- END RESUME ---',
  ...(job.layout === 'house-template'
    ? ['', '--- EXTRACTED RESUME TEXT (the only facts you may use) ---',
       job.extractedFacts, '--- END EXTRACTED TEXT ---']
    : []),
  '',
  'Rewrite the resume LaTeX so it targets the role above. Output the full LaTeX document only.',
].join('\n');

return [{
  json: {
    ...job,
    payload: {
      model: cfg.model || 'auto',
      messages: [
        { role: 'system', content: system },
        { role: 'user', content: user },
      ],
    },
  },
}];

nodes.name: Build Prompt
nodes.notes: The tailoring prompt. The one-page budget and the LaTeX-correctness rules are what keep the compile loop from being needed; account-level rules come from Config.resumeConstraints.

nodes.name: Compile Attempt
nodes.notes: Entry point of the compile loop. Refuses to run without a role folder id: Drive would silently drop the files in My Drive root instead of failing.

nodes.name: Compile Input
nodes.notes: Both the first attempt and every retry pass through here, so this node's run index always matches Compile PDF's.

nodes.name: Compile PDF
nodes.notes: Self-hosted LaTeX service (latex-pdf/docker-compose.yml). 200 returns the PDF, 422 returns {error,log}. neverError is what lets the 422 be read instead of killing the row.

nodes.name: Compiled Resume
nodes.notes: The single source of truth after the loop. Downstream must read HERE, not Clean LaTeX: on a retry Clean LaTeX still holds the first, broken attempt.

nodes.name: Parse Compile Error
nodes.notes: Decodes the 422 body and keeps only the 'file.tex:LINE:' lines. Runs before the retry decision so the give-up branch has the log too.

nodes.name: Build Fix Prompt
nodes.notes: Minimal-repair prompt built from the decoded compiler log.

nodes.name: Clean Fixed LaTeX
nodes.notes: Loops back into Compile Input with attempt+1. The filename is preserved, never recomputed.

nodes.name: Status Failed
nodes.notes: Overwrites status.json in place (media upload on the existing file id), so the folder never collects duplicate markers.

parameters.jsCode:
const cfg = $('Config').first().json;
const job = $('Compiled Resume').first().json;

const system = [
  'You are an expert career writer who drafts concise, specific cover letters.',
  '',
  'OUTPUT FORMAT',
  '- Output ONLY the body paragraphs of the cover letter, as plain text.',
  '- Separate paragraphs with one blank line. No markdown, no **bold**, no bullet points,',
  '  no HTML tags, no code fences, no commentary before or after.',
  '- Do NOT write a greeting, a date, an address block, a subject line or a sign-off.',
  '  Those are added around your text automatically. Start with the first body sentence.',
  '',
  'CONTENT RULES',
  '- 4 short paragraphs, 280-350 words total. It must read in under a minute.',
  '- Paragraph 1: the role and company by name, and one sentence on why this role fits.',
  '- Paragraph 2: the two most relevant proof points from the resume, with their real numbers.',
  '- Paragraph 3: one specific thing from the job description you would own on day one.',
  '- Paragraph 4: a short, plain closing with a call to talk.',
  '',
  'HONESTY',
  '- Use only facts present in the resume. Never invent employers, dates, numbers or degrees.',
  '- Never change a metric or a date range.',
  '- Mirror the job description vocabulary only where it is factually honest.',
  '',
  'TONE',
  '- Direct and human. No "I am writing to express my interest", no "esteemed organisation",',
  '  no flattery, no buzzword stacking. Never use an em dash.',
].join('\n');

const user = [
  'JOB TITLE: ' + (job.title || 'n/a'),
  'COMPANY: ' + (job.company || 'n/a'),
  'DEPARTMENT: ' + (job.department || 'n/a'),
  '',
  'JOB DESCRIPTION:',
  job.description || '(none provided)',
  '',
  '--- TAILORED RESUME (LaTeX, source of truth for every fact) ---',
  job.latex,
  '--- END RESUME ---',
  '',
  'Write the cover letter body as plain text paragraphs.',
].join('\n');

return [{
  json: {
    ...job,
    coverPayload: {
      model: cfg.model || 'auto',
      messages: [
        { role: 'system', content: system },
        { role: 'user', content: user },
      ],
    },
  },
}];

nodes.name: Build Cover Letter DOCX
nodes.notes: Writes a real .docx (OOXML in a STORED-only zip) with no npm dependency. Edit the para() calls to change fonts, sizes or spacing.

nodes.name: Upload Cover DOCX
nodes.notes: Uploads the .docx as-is into the per-company subfolder. Set 'Convert to Google Document' in options if you also want an editable Google Doc.

nodes.name: Build Cover Letter LaTeX
nodes.notes: Same paragraphs, rendered as a bare article so the folder also holds a PDF cover letter.

nodes.name: Compile Cover PDF
nodes.notes: One attempt, no fix loop. A plain letter has little to break, and a cover-letter PDF failure must not sink a job whose resume already compiled.

nodes.name: Status Done
nodes.notes: The app polls for exactly this. Nothing is transferred back: the artifacts stay in Drive.

nodes.name: Status Webhook
nodes.notes: GET /webhook/resume/tailor/<folderId>. Same Header Auth credential as Intake. Answers from status.json in that folder, so it keeps working across n8n restarts and from any worker.

parameters.name: q
parameters.value: =name = 'status.json' and '{{ $('Status Webhook').first().json.params.folderId }}' in parents and trashed = false

nodes.name: Download Status File
nodes.notes: neverError + continueOnFail: a folder with no marker yet must read as 'running', not as an error.

nodes.name: Resolve Upload
nodes.notes: Normalises the uploaded files to the binary names 'tex' and 'pdf', and fails with the list of what actually arrived rather than a misleading extraction error.
